output.summary: KEP-2273 proposed CRI API changes so container resource fields can be updated for in-place pod vertical scaling. Its status is implementable at alpha stage, with the kubelet, kube-apiserver and kube-scheduler behind a feature gate.
output.rationale: The sources cover the PRR review on PR #2474, not the design itself. Reviewers asked for Upgrade/Downgrade and Version Skew sections, and the author documented that an API server with the feature on but an older kubelet would restart containers on a resource PATCH. Reviewers approved PRR for alpha on that basis, and sig-node approvers (dchen1107) approved the KEP.

alternatives.option: Graduate directly past alpha with the feature gate on in the API server first
alternatives.why_not: The sources say the version skew issue means it would delay GA, since the feature gate must be on in kubelets before removing it in the API server; the author instead targeted beta for 1.24 with the gate default-off in alpha.

alternatives.option: Keep alpha at n+2 kubelet compatibility without changes
alternatives.why_not: The author asked whether stretching alpha to n+2 was reasonable, and ehashman said she did not think beta should be delayed; the sources do not record an explicit decision on this option.

evidence.quote: I requested @Random-Liu a last minute review on CRI-related extension last Tuesday.
I don't think we should delay beta, but this would delay GA, since we'd need to ensure that the feature gate was on in kubelets before removing it in the API server.
This is why we ask these questions, to catch them before we've implemented it without a strategy
I've updated the KEPs to target 1.24 for beta. This way we will not have to worry about the above issue in n-2 kubelet versions surprising anyone as alpha has feature-gate default-off.
/approve I think PRR is good to go for alpha. @derekwaynecarr @dchen1107 can you please give this a final approval?
